prompt: Each time i invest 17800 i earn 18800 in return, then i re invest the same amount. Do this 4 time per days for 5 days , each weeks. My question what would be my profit after 2 year and 5  months in euros ?
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 correctly computes profit per cycle (€1,000), scales by 4 investments/day and 5 days/week, and converts the 2 years + 5 months duration using an average weeks-per-month approach (resulting €2,514,500) without introducing unnecessary currency conversion.
